---
title: Exploring complex text corpora
---


- a [digital Complutensian polyglot Bible](https://neelsmith.github.io/digital-complutensian/): digital resources for both experts and novices, supporting aligned multilingual reading. 
- the **Homer Multitext project**:  Current work includes [experimenting with "two coffee" apps](https://neelsmith.github.io/mousike).
- [*mousike*](https://neelsmith.github.io/mousike) (ancient Greek music): work with musical documents aligning text and musical notation.
